text:
anna: seeing a weird tail-latency bump on mistral-8x7b when sequences hit max_position_embeddings=2048. baseline p95 was 85ms, now 100ms+ on the same config :confused:
sam: do you have a repro script or a minimal request trace?
anna: minimal repro: sliding-window attention, window=1024, rope_scale=0.5, batch_size constant=8. It only shows up when sequence_len >= 2048 exactly (boundary).
raj: sounds like an edge-case in the kernel selector when seq==max_pos. any kernel fallback in the trace?
anna: yes, profiler shows initial choice matmul_fused_attn, then fallback to tiled_attention on a subset of buckets. profile excerpt:
```
[PROFILE] kernel_selector: chosen=matmul_fused_attn
[PROFILE] runtime: fallback -> tiled_attention for seq_bucket=2048
[PROFILE] p95_before=85ms p95_after=100ms delta=+17%
```
tyler: interesting — could be RoPE precompute or mask handling forcing a different codepath. do we have mask patterns?
anna: mask is sliding window (causal + 1024 lookback), but at the exact maxpos the mask generation flips to an alternate masked-ops path in our mask optimizer. looks like mask optimizer returns masked_dense=true when seq==max_pos.
raj: that would change kernel affordances. masked_dense=true disables matmul_fused path (which assumes unmasked contiguous matmul). fallback explains perf hit.
sam: can you try forcing kernel selector to skip masked-ops for this case? env var KERNEL_FORCE=tiled_attention would reproduce consistent behavior but not ideal.
anna: quick test: forcing matmul_fused_attn when seq==2048 yields p95 back to ~86ms. so kernel choice is indeed the cause.
tyler: why does mask optimizer treat boundary seq differently? maybe we calc padding==0 then classify as full mask? check mask code around max_position_embeddings edge.
perf-bot: automated trace uploaded: https://internal/redwood/profiles/1945678901
raj: short-term fix: add a special-case in mask-optimizer to treat seq==max_pos as non-masked for sliding-window patterns if padding==0. add unit and perf test.
anna: filing a small PR with tests + perf guard. PR draft: https://git/internal/pull/3248 (WIP).
sam: also add a regression test to perf-dashboard to catch kernel-choice flips: assert kernel_selector stable across seq in [max_pos-2, max_pos].
tyler: long-term: kernel_selector should consider mask-optimizer heuristic confidence and avoid switching to a slower codepath for one-off boundary hits. file an RFC?
raj: agreed. I'll pair with anna on the PR. tagging @perf-bot to run nightly benchmark after merge. :thumbsup:
